reviews.title: Tight, Fast, Tiny Drive
reviews.comment:
This little Kingston Drive is very small... ( 22 x 30 cm as one can discern from its model num).
But it has a lot of power packed into that tiny size.  It's FAST, EFFICIENT and works great as a Win11 updated SSD
Great value for the money, too...
Excellent Drive!
reviews.author: JJ

reviews.title: Great price to performance ratio
reviews.comment: Have a 10Gbps Magnetic M.2 NVMe SSD Enclosure https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0FMJR4Z88 that I was looking for a reliable yet reasonably priced 2TB drive. This Kingston drive had the best price at the time. It performs well in the drive and is excellent for backing up photos and video. I highly recommend this drive.
reviews.author: A. Deal Finder

reviews.title: It’s really fast…!!!
reviews.comment: Great writing speed, when formatting it was performed in a blink. I’m very satisfied with this product; also purchased a Sharge enclosure which is eye catching and absolutely convenient. However, Kingston really is breaking its own standards. Great, absolutely great SSD at a very convenient size (if you’re planning to use it as an external drive.
reviews.author: Rouget Chamier

reviews.title: My desktop is back from the dead
reviews.comment: My SK Hynix died on me mid-game. Kingston was delivered fast and was packaged securely. I replaced the part, reinstalled the os, and everything works perfectly!
reviews.author: Beeperz

reviews.title: Worth it
reviews.comment: Great price, threw it in a gaming laptop and runs beautifully with no issues. Runs games like starfield and cod with almost no load time.
